value: Meridian Health System: Seven Use Cases, Zero Decision-Grade Outputs Without Evidence Closure

Meridian operates as an integrated health system and health plan on Epic, with a fragmented on-prem analytics estate across SQL Server, Tableau, Power BI, and SAS. An outsourced managed services provider consumes approximately 80% of analytics delivery capacity on maintenance, leaving minimal bandwidth for net-new work. AWS and Databricks are the stated target platform direction but are not production-ready, and no certified medallion architecture exists. Nexus has mapped 19 dimensions across 146 evidence references and 3,487 source rows, confirming system inventory, use case intent, and the risk landscape with high confidence.\n\nSeven enterprise use cases are in scope — lakehouse, AI/LLM governance, call center optimization, provider quality, cost transparency, payment integrity, and automated close — and all remain in planning stage. Four pervasive blockers affect every use case simultaneously: no certified medallion architecture, no formal data governance operating model, no certified semantic layer, and no patient/member identity spine. No use case can reach decision grade, and no value can be quantified, until these foundational gaps are closed. The immediate executive decision is sequencing: which evidence gates to close first, and who owns accountability for each.
